label: ferrosome
definition: A morphology trait in which a bacterial cell forms membrane-bound ferrosome organelles that store intracellular iron as non-crystalline iron phosphate biomineral.
observations: Ferrosome branch under intracellular inclusion; distinct from generic iron biomineralization, free intracellular iron particles, magnetosomes, ferritin-like proteinaceous iron-storage compartments, individual Fez proteins, the fez operon outside a complete ferrosome-forming organism-level morphology trait, and host-colonization outputs in Clostridioides difficile.
